_meta.note: Starter dataset compiled from official government web pages read on the last_verified date. verification_status: partially_verified = key facts read from an official page, other fields marked as not stated; low_confidence = status or details uncertain. Always confirm with the official website.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: A Central Government income-support scheme for eligible landholding small and marginal farmer families.
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000 per year, transferred in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months, directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible landholding small and marginal farmer families. Detailed inclusion and exclusion rules are not reproduced in the sources used here; check the PM-KISAN portal guidelines.
schemes.documents: Not listed in the sources used here (the portal states payments go to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts). Confirm the document list on the official portal.
schemes.application_process: Farmers can register online through the 'Register as a New Farmer' option on the PM-KISAN portal by providing the required details.
schemes.verification_notes: Benefit amount and instalment pattern read from the National Portal service page. Eligibility details, exclusions and documents were not available in the pages that could be read, and are marked unverified.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: A health assurance scheme providing cashless hospitalisation cover to identified poor and vulnerable families.
schemes.benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation, on a family-floater basis. No cap on family size, age or gender, and pre-existing conditions are covered from day one. Treatment is cashless at empanelled public and private hospitals.
schemes.eligibility: Bottom 40% of poor and vulnerable families, identified using deprivation and occupational criteria of the Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011. Rural families meeting at least one deprivation criterion or an automatic-inclusion category; urban workers in listed occupational categories. States may use their own databases in some cases.
schemes.documents: Not specified as a fixed list in the source used. Beneficiary identification is by database; ask the Arogya Mitra help desk at an empanelled hospital what identity proof is needed.
schemes.application_process: There is no advance enrolment process; the scheme is entitlement-based. Eligibility can be checked on the Citizen Portal (mera.pmjay.gov.in) or through the Citizen Call Centre (14555). Each empanelled hospital has a help desk staffed by Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitras.
schemes.verification_notes: Read from the National Health Authority page. The source describes SECC-2011 based coverage; some States have expanded coverage (for example to senior citizens), which is not covered here and should be checked officially.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.description: A Central housing scheme for urban households in the EWS, LIG and MIG segments, implemented through four verticals.
schemes.benefits: Housing support through four verticals: Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) and Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS). Specific subsidy amounts are not reproduced here; see the operational guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Urban EWS, LIG or MIG households with no pucca house in the name of any family member anywhere in India. Annual household income: EWS up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG Rs 3-6 lakh; MIG Rs 6-9 lakh. BLC is for EWS families; AHP for EWS; ARH for EWS/LIG; ISS for EWS, LIG and MIG. Exclusions include families who received a Central, State or local housing benefit in the last 20 years, and NRIs. ISS has limits on loan size, house value and carpet area.
schemes.documents: General: Aadhaar, bank account details, eligibility undertaking in the prescribed format. BLC: proof of identity, proof of address, income certificate, land ownership documents, affidavit of not owning a pucca house. ISS: Aadhaar and PAN, proof of address, income certificate, and others specified by lenders or the Ministry.
schemes.application_process: Apply in the prescribed format through the Unified Web Portal of PMAY-U 2.0, a Common Service Centre, or the concerned Urban Local Body. For ISS, register the demand on the portal and provide home-loan details of the lending institution; applying directly through the lender is not allowed.
schemes.verification_notes: Read from the PMAY-U 2.0 FAQ on the official MIS portal. The pmay-urban.gov.in home page could not be fetched in this session. Subsidy amounts were not confirmed.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (via National Scholarship Portal)
schemes.description: A Central scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker families in Government, Government-aided and local body schools, applied for through the National Scholarships Portal (NSP).
schemes.benefits: A scholarship for eligible students. The scholarship amount is not stated in the source used here; check the scheme guidelines on the portal.
schemes.eligibility: Students of Government, Government-aided or local body schools who meet the scheme guidelines; at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) to appear in the selection test, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students; parental income from all sources not more than Rs 3,50,000 per annum.
schemes.documents: Nothing needs to be uploaded on the portal. Fresh applicants submit to their school: income certificate of parent or guardian from the competent authority, and caste certificate (where applicable).
schemes.application_process: Apply online (fresh or renewal) at scholarships.gov.in using One Time Registration. A draft can be saved and edited until submission. An Application ID is sent by SMS; the application is then verified by the school or institute and by the domicile district.
schemes.verification_notes: Read from the NMMSS FAQ hosted on the NSP. NSP lists many other scholarship schemes (merit based and welfare based) from several ministries, each with its own rules and dates; only NMMSS is included in this starter set. Application windows change every year and must be checked on the portal.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: A small-savings scheme for the girl child, to be operated by a parent or guardian, intended for her education and marriage expenses.
schemes.benefits: A savings account with deposits of up to Rs 1.5 lakh in a financial year. Partial withdrawal is allowed for the girl's higher education under scheme rules. The interest rate is revised periodically by the Government and is not stated here; check the current rate with the post office or bank.
schemes.eligibility: A girl child who is under 10 years of age when the account is opened and who is a resident Indian. One account per girl child; generally up to two girl children per family, with exceptions such as twins or triplets on documentary proof.
schemes.documents: Girl child's birth certificate; guardian's identity proof and address proof; photograph and other KYC documents.
schemes.application_process: Open the account at a post office offering small savings schemes or at an authorised bank branch. Deposits are required for up to 15 years; the account matures 21 years after opening, or earlier on the girl's marriage after age 18 subject to conditions.
schemes.verification_notes: Two government pages gave different minimum deposits (Rs 250 on the West Bengal Government page; Rs 1,000 on a MyGov page). The figure is therefore left out of the benefits text; confirm the current minimum at the post office. The official website field points to the Department of Posts home page, which was not itself fetched.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: A pension scheme, administered by PFRDA, aimed particularly at workers in the unorganised sector.
schemes.benefits: A guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 after the age of 60, as chosen by the subscriber, payable until death.
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years who have a savings bank account with a bank or the Department of Posts. A person who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to join, with effect from 1 October 2022.
schemes.documents: APY registration form; savings bank or post office account details. Other KYC requirements are set by the bank or post office.
schemes.application_process: Fill the APY registration form available at bank branches and post offices and submit it there, or join online through eAPY. The subscriber pays the prescribed contribution from the age of joining until age 60; the amount depends on the chosen pension and joining age and is not stated here.
schemes.verification_notes: Read from the PFRDA page. Contribution amounts were not stated there.

schemes.name: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) - VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 (replaces MGNREGA)
schemes.description: A rural wage-employment framework that, according to Government of India and State Government pages, replaces the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).
schemes.benefits: A guarantee of 125 days of wage employment per rural household in each financial year (earlier entitlement under MGNREGA was 100 days), with an aggregated no-work period of up to 60 days during peak agricultural seasons. Wages are to be paid weekly or not later than a fortnight; a daily unemployment allowance becomes payable if work is not provided, as per rules.
schemes.eligibility: Rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. Further criteria are to be set by rules and were not available in the sources read.
schemes.documents: Not stated in the sources read. Under the earlier MGNREGA system a job card was used; whether and how this continues should be confirmed with the Gram Panchayat.
schemes.application_process: Not described in the sources read. Contact the Gram Panchayat or the district rural development office for the current registration procedure.
schemes.verification_notes: IMPORTANT: The user brief listed MGNREGA. Sources read in this session indicate MGNREGA has been replaced by the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025. The PIB backgrounder (18 December 2025) describes it as a Bill; a State Government page says Parliament has passed it and that it replaces MGNREGA; news reports state Presidential assent in December 2025. No official commencement date or registration procedure was found. Treat this record as low confidence and verify on the Ministry of Rural Development website before relying on it. The official website field points to a State Government page because a national page was not confirmed.
